# HEM v0.6.1b24 — Unified Home, Room, and Device settings

This beta consolidates settings categories throughout the HEM card without modifying physical control policy, room sources or HACS packaging.

- **Home:** the saved Home Options flow and immediately applied Home device controls now share *one* accordion per subject: Weather/outdoor, Air quality/limits, Presence/sleep/arrival, Windows/ventilation, Announcements/delivery, Power/protection.
- **Room:** seven original source selectors remain independent, but are nested under compact unified categories alongside the room's native HEM controls. Room measurements/targets, Equipment/control/PID, Presence/sleep, Windows/ventilation/shading, Power/protection and Announcements/errors have no duplicated headings.
- **Device:** native controls are grouped into six coherent categories (Control/targets/fans, PID/calibration, Presence/sleep, Windows/ventilation, Power/protection, Announcements/errors).
- **No Other bucket:** remaining fields are placed in functional groups using immutable HEM keys and translated labels, without dropping unknown records.
- **No duplicated editors:** when a Home Options field and native configuration entity name the same persisted setting, the Options-flow editor takes precedence so Save cannot overwrite a simultaneous immediately-applied edit.
- **Same save/identity guards:** draft options still save only through the validated HA Options flow; native controls still target the exact entity via the existing service guard. Registry and config-entry/area/device scoping remain unchanged.
- **Focus and error preservation:** grouped dialogs preserve expanded sections, unsaved form values and focused native editors during live refresh. Native warnings and invalid source selections stay visible.
- **Translations:** grouped headings and timing labels in EN/EL/DE with English fallback for other locales.

No HACS/Marketplace changes. No restarts or physical-device commands are part of this release.
